<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  // ==========================================
  // 1. FORMULARIO Y CONFIGURACIÓN
  // ==========================================

  const form = document.querySelector(
    'form.elementor-form[name="Request Information"]'
  );

  if (!form) {
    console.error("SABER: Formulario no encontrado.");
    return;
  }

  const API_URL = "https://api.verityiq.com/api/leadpost";

  const TEST_MODE = false;

  const THANK_YOU_URL = "/thank-you/";

  const CONFIG = {
    veritySysKey: "vliffv08",
    tenantid: "85",
    schoolname: "Saber College",
    campus: "Miami",
    campaignname: "Request Info Website",
    pub_id: "Saber",
    CPL: "Saber"
  };

  const getField = (id) =>
    form.querySelector("#form-field-" + id);

  const getValue = (id) =>
    (getField(id)?.value || "").trim();

  const params = new URLSearchParams(
    window.location.search
  );

  // ==========================================
  // 2. FUNCIONES AUXILIARES
  // ==========================================

  function normalizePhone(value) {
    let digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (
      digits.length === 11 &&
      digits.startsWith("1")
    ) {
      digits = digits.slice(1);
    }

    return digits;
  }

  function generateLeadId() {
    if (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) {
      return "M" + crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return "M" + Date.now().toString();
  }

  function getCampaign() {
    const source = (
      params.get("utm_source") || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const medium = (
      params.get("utm_medium") || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const isPaid =
      ["cpc", "ppc", "paid", "paid_search"].includes(medium) ||
      ["google_ads", "googleads"].includes(source);

    return {
      campaigntype: isPaid
        ? "Paid Search"
        : "Organic SEO",

      campaigncode: isPaid
        ? "Google Ads Landing Page"
        : "Request Info Website",

      leadsource: isPaid
        ? "Google"
        : "Website"
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 3. CONSTRUIR DATOS DEL LEAD
  // ==========================================

  function createLead() {
    const campaign = getCampaign();

    const lead = {
      ...CONFIG,

      campaigntype: campaign.campaigntype,
      campaigncode: campaign.campaigncode,
      leadsource: campaign.leadsource,

      leadid: generateLeadId(),

      fname: getValue("fname"),
      lname: getValue("lname"),
      email: getValue("email"),

      phone: normalizePhone(
        getValue("phone")
      ),

      address: getValue("street"),
      city: getValue("city"),
      zip: getValue("zip"),

      program: getValue("program"),

      consent: "yes"
    };

    // Agregar parámetros de seguimiento
    [
      "utm_source",
      "utm_medium",
      "utm_campaign",
      "utm_content",
      "utm_term",
      "utm_device",
      "utm_matchtype",
      "Code_Id",
      "adposition",
      "creative_id",
      "network",
      "gclid",
      "fbclid"
    ].forEach((key) => {
      const value = params.get(key);

      if (value) {
        lead[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return lead;
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 4. VALIDACIONES
  // ==========================================

  function validateLead(lead) {

    if (!lead.fname || !lead.lname) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter your full name."
      );
    }

    if (
      !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(
        lead.email
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter a valid email address."
      );
    }

    if (
      !/^[2-9]\d{2}[2-9]\d{6}$/.test(
        lead.phone
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter a valid US phone number."
      );
    }

    if (!lead.program) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please select a program."
      );
    }

  }

  // ==========================================
  // 5. LIMPIAR FORMULARIO
  // ==========================================

  function clearForm() {

    form.reset();

    // Limpiar campos visibles.
    [
      "fname",
      "lname",
      "email",
      "phone"
    ].forEach((id) => {
      const input = getField(id);

      if (input) {
        input.value = "";
      }
    });

    // Mantener program y campus porque son
    // campos ocultos configurados en Elementor.

    // Actualizar intl-tel-input si está disponible.
    const phoneInput = getField("phone");

    if (
      phoneInput &&
      window.intlTelInput &&
      typeof window.intlTelInput.getInstance === "function"
    ) {
      const instance =
        window.intlTelInput.getInstance(phoneInput);

      if (instance) {
        instance.setNumber("");
      }
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 6. ENVÍO A VERITY IQ
  // ==========================================

  let submitting = false;

  form.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    if (submitting) return;

    const button = form.querySelector(
      '[type="submit"]'
    );

    try {

      const lead = createLead();

      validateLead(lead);

      if (TEST_MODE) {
        console.table(lead);

        alert(
          "Test mode: no lead was sent."
        );

        return;
      }

      submitting = true;

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }

      // Enviar datos a Verity IQ
      const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
        },
        body: new URLSearchParams(lead).toString()
      });

      const result = await response.text();

      console.log(
        "VERITY HTTP STATUS:",
        response.status
      );

      console.log(
        "VERITY RESPONSE:",
        result
      );

      // Validar respuesta HTTP
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          "Verity IQ HTTP error: " +
          response.status
        );
      }

      // Verity puede devolver "success" como texto
      // o como cadena JSON.
      let parsedResult = result;

      try {
        parsedResult = JSON.parse(result);
      } catch (e) {
        // La respuesta no es JSON.
      }

      const isSuccess =
        typeof parsedResult === "string" &&
        parsedResult.trim().toLowerCase() === "success";

      if (!isSuccess) {
        throw new Error(
          "Verity IQ did not confirm success."
        );
      }

      // ======================================
      // 7. ENVÍO EXITOSO
      // ======================================

      console.log(
        "SABER: Lead enviado correctamente."
      );

      // Evento de conversión para GTM.
      if (window.dataLayer) {
        window.dataLayer.push({
          event: "formSubmission",
          formName: "formProfessionalNursing",
          formCampus: lead.campus,
          formProgram: lead.program,
          leadId: lead.leadid,

          utm_source: lead.utm_source || "",
          utm_medium: lead.utm_medium || "",
          utm_campaign: lead.utm_campaign || ""
        });
      }

      // Limpiar los campos del formulario.
      clearForm();

      // Redireccionar a la página de gracias.
      window.location.assign(THANK_YOU_URL);

    } catch (error) {

      console.error(
        "SABER VERITY ERROR:",
        error
      );

      alert(
        "We couldn't process your request. " +
        "Please try again."
      );

    } finally {

      submitting = false;

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = false;
      }

    }

  }, true);

});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const input = document.querySelector("#form-field-phone");

  if (!input) return;

  /*
   * Bloquea escritura manual de indicativos distintos a +1
   * Ejemplo bloqueado: +57, +52, +34, +44
   */
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    const value = input.value.trim();

    if (value.startsWith("+") && !value.startsWith("+1")) {
      input.value = "+1";
    }
  });

  /*
   * Bloquea pegado de indicativos distintos a +1
   */
  input.addEventListener("paste", function (event) {
    const pastedText = (event.clipboardData || window.clipboardData)
      .getData("text")
      .trim();

    if (pastedText.startsWith("+") && !pastedText.startsWith("+1")) {
      event.preventDefault();
      input.value = "+1";
      alert("Only US phone numbers starting with +1 are allowed.");
    }
  });

});
</script>

settings.title: Nursing A.S. Degree Program Overview

When you decide to become a nurse, you choose to change lives, including your own. In our registered nursing program, you’ll develop the skills you need for a career in caregiving. The degree program will allow you to take charge of your future and practice in a safe, supportive, and stimulating environment. The ASN program is designed to help registered nurses (RN) improve their skills through didactic and clinical experiences that prepare them for various roles in nursing practice.

There are a lot of accelerated nursing programs out there, and it can be hard to determine the right fit. At SABER College of Nursing, we understand that the future of healthcare relies on nurses who are educated in evidence-based practice. We pride ourselves on our small class sizes, which allow for individualized attention from faculty and students. This attention translates into helping you potentially attain workplace readiness faster.
What Do You Learn In Nursing School?

Before starting to work as a registered nurse, it is wise to review some of the core concepts you will need to know to provide safe and effective patient care. These include anatomy and physiology, nutrition and diet, microbiology and nursing pharmacology, and lessons on how drugs work in the body.

It’s also essential for you to build a network of peers in your classes. When exam time rolls around, you can study together and help each other with any confusing concepts. If a group study session isn’t your jam, try getting a tutor or study buddy who can help you review critical concepts before your exams.

Finally, remember that feeling overwhelmed is normal! Talk with friends who have been through nursing school before you.  Successful students can tell you what it was like for them and how they coped with challenging classes and stressful assignments.
What Do Professional Nurses (RNs) Do?

Nurses offer various services to patients in a hospital or clinic setting. They perform physical exams and take detailed health care histories. They are also the first to run blood, urine, and other tests, administer medications ordered by physicians, and treat injuries. Nurses may also be called upon to chart a patient’s progress, counsel patients on diet changes or lifestyle modifications, and assist doctors during surgery.
The key responsibilities of a nurse are:

icon_list.text: Being the primary point of contact for patients and their families
Providing a wide range of health care services, including administering medication, operating medical equipment, dressing wounds, and recording patient information
Maintaining accurate and complete medical records.
Responding to emergencies when they occur and assisting in emergencies
Collaborating with other health care professionals to coordinate patient care plans and ensure quality patient outcomes

settings.title: What It Means To Be A NCLEX RN
Being a nurse is an important job: you help people. But the NCLEX-RN offers the opportunity to do even more than that.

The NCLEX-RN serves as a guide for examination development and candidate preparation. The NCLEX® examination assesses the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for the entry-level nurse to meet clients' needs requiring the promotion, maintenance, or restoration of health.
It's hard to be a nurse, but completing your NCLEX-RN is one way you can help make sure that you're ready for anything that comes your way.
What is the difference between ADN, AASN, and ASN nursing programs?
ADN, ASN, and AASN programs are all Associate degrees in nursing—but they're not the same.

The most crucial difference between them is that the Associate of Science in Nursing (ASN) focuses on preparing students for higher-level degrees. At the same time, the Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) and the Associate of Applied Science in Nursing (AASN) focus on teaching students how to be entry-level nurses.

icon_list.text: ASN and ADN nursing programs may prepare nurses more for clinical work than bachelor's-level programs.
AASN nursing programs may prepare nurses more for supervisory work within their field than ASN or ADN programs.

settings.title: The main reason you'd want to get an ASN is if you think you might want to go on and get a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN). With an ASN, you'll need fewer credits to complete a BSN than with an ADN or AASN—meaning less time and money spent getting your next degree.

In general, ADNs and AASNs are considered more flexible than ASNs. If you don't know that you want to go into nursing, or if you have other commitments that require a flexible schedule, this may be the path for you.
It's also worth noting that some employers prefer ADNs or AASNs because they consider them to be more directly related to their field than ASNs. It all depends on where you're applying.
Professional Nursing Program Curriculum

The curriculum is designed to help you develop the skills, knowledge, and attitude you need to be confident in sitting for the NCLEX-RN exam. This program is designed for students who are interested in pursuing a career as a nurse. It includes coursework that covers topics such as medical terminology, anatomy and physiology (including pathology), pharmacology, and nutrition. We provide the education and credentials to support your lifelong learning journey, of becoming a registered nurse.

Total Program Credit Hours- 80
Total Program Clock Hours- 1725
** Online Courses.
The Professional Nursing Program (PNP) at Saber College

The Professional Nursing Program (PNP) at SABER is an intensive, full-time program comprised of 80 credit hours/1,725 clock hours, including theory, lab, and clinical rotation experience. This experience will cover medical/surgical nursing, obstetric-gynecologic nursing, pediatric nursing, gerontologic nursing, and psychiatric nursing.

Reinforcement of basic skills in English, mathematics, and sciences appropriate for the preparatory job program will occur through didactic instruction and applied laboratory procedures/practice. This program is designed to prepare graduates to utilize and apply the nursing process to provide nursing care to clients across their lifespans in various settings. Upon completing the curriculum and passing a comprehensive exit exam, graduates will receive an Associate of Science Degree in Nursing (ASN) from Saber College of Nursing.

The Professional Nursing Program (PNP) is fully accredited by the Council on Occupational Education (COE) and licensed by the Commission for Independent Education (CIE). SABER College holds pre-accreditation status from the National League for Nursing Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLNCNEA)

The Saber College Associate Degree in Nursing Program holds initial accreditation from the National League for Nursing Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLN CNEA), located at 2600 Virginia Avenue, NW, Washington, DC 20037. 202-909-2487.
